item.title: New federal rule could lower disability compensation for millions of veterans: VFW
item.description: A federal rule change could lower disability compensation for millions of veterans, says the Veterans of Foreign Wars.

item.title: Publix releases 19 new limited-edition ice cream flavors
item.description: Publix announced its newest lineup of ice cream flavors, which include a total of 19 flavors inspired by cookies, cakes and drinks.

item.title: $14M in surgical robotic arms stolen from Florida hospital in multi-year scheme
item.description: A man was arrested last week in connection with a multi-year theft scheme involving millions of dollars' worth of medical equipment being stolen from a Jacksonville hospital.

item.title: Mexican authorities say no formal FBI request in Guthrie case
item.description: The attorney general of the Mexican state of Sonora clarified Wednesday that his office has not received a formal request from the FBI to collaborate in the search for 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie.

item.title: U.S. wins 3rd gold in women's hockey against Canada
item.description: United States wins its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller's goal in overtime.

item.title: 'Rogue' cow lassoed after running loose on Florida highway
item.description: A "rogue" cow was sent "back to greener pastures" on Monday after it was spotted running loose on a Florida highway and eventually lassoed by its owner.

item.title: Alysa Liu gives US its first women's figure skating Olympic gold in 24 years
item.description: Alysa Liu wins first women's figure skating gold medal for the US in 24 years at Milan Cortina Games

item.title: Dozens of manatees found dead around Florida river within 1 week, FWC says
item.description: Officials have seen an increasing number of manatees turning up dead in the Orange River, the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC) said Thursday.

item.title: Workforce housing project decades in the making coming to Sarasota
item.description: One Stop Housing recently celebrated the groundbreaking of its latest workforce housing project, Sarasota Station.

item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star, has died at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became an advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.
